summary_en: ¥330.0M upper limit. 150,000 shares (2.53% of S/O ex-treasury). ToSTNeT-3 method. Execution window 14–21 Jul 2026. Price ceiling not disclosed. Rationale: capital-efficiency improvement and flexible capital-allocation execution.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on the Provisions of the Articles of Incorporation under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: Niitaka's board resolved on 13 July 2026 to authorize treasury-stock acquisition under Articles 459(1) of the Companies Act and Article 41 of the Articles of Incorporation. The program targets 150,000 shares (2.53% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock) with a yen upper limit of ¥330.0 million. Execution will occur via ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction negotiated trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) during 14–21 July 2026. No unit price ceiling is specified. The stated rationale is to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital-allocation strategy. As of 31 May 2026, the company held 14,632 treasury shares against a base of 5,928,420 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
